newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Shell Australia collieries workers return.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Shell Australia collieries workers return.

text.p: Shell Australia Ltd said its German Creek mines in central Queensland had resumed full production after striking mine workers returned to work after a three-day stoppage.
The colliery workers, who went on an indefinite strike last Wednesday over the dismissal of a union offical for misconduct, returned to work at 11 p.m. (1300 GMT) on Sunday.
Estimates of lost production were not immediately available but appeared minimal as the mines did not work weekend shifts, a Shell Australia spokesman said.
The return to work had been ordered by the Australian Industrial Relations Commission.
"We are very satisfied with the outcome and look forward to an orderly return to work," mine manager, Mitch Jakeman said in a statement.

The German Creek mines, managed by Capricorn Coal Management Pty Ltd, comprise two underground mines and an open-cut mine with a combined production capability of five million tonnes annually for the export metallurgical coal market.
